## v1.3.3

### Round availability fix

- Fixed setup failures when EuroLeague lists a new regular-season round before standings for that round are published.
- If the newest standings endpoint returns HTTP 404, the integration now automatically tries earlier rounds and uses the latest round with published standings.
- Example: if Round 4 is already scheduled but Round 4 standings are not available yet, Round 3 standings remain visible instead of the integration failing setup.
- Added `scheduled_round` and `round_fallback` sensor attributes for easier diagnostics.
- Other API errors still use the persistent last-known standings cache when available.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/braticks/euroleague-standings/compare/v1.3.2...v1.3.3
